feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 4 August 2026 7:26am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 04 August 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure now lies over Ireland, with associated fronts affecting the Irish Sea at first today.


##Wind##

South 4 or 5, veering South or Southwest this afternoon and evening, occasionally touching 6 over some central and western parts for a time in the late afternoon and evening. Veering West early tonight, increasing West or Southwest 5 or 6 later in night.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate tonight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain and drizzle and areas of mist this morning, then becoming fair later this morning or afternoon.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor at times at first, then generally good from this afternoon onwards.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 by about midday, then touching gale 8 in places later in the day. Veering West or Northwest overnight into Thursday and decreasing 5 or 6.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming moderate or rough for a time.


##Weather##

Scattered showers, rain for a time in places.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, possibly moderate in showers or rain.
